subject: Greenhouse + Checkr + LearnPort — bundled renewal coordination
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Greenhouse + Checkr + LearnPort — renewal bundling proposal

Hi team,

Attached is a consolidated renewal summary for our HR stack: Greenhouse (applicants + interviews), Checkr (background checks), and LearnPort (LMS). Key asks:

- Approve pursuing a bundled negotiation (one PO covering the three vendors) to capture the vendor-offered discounts.
- Confirm headcount projection used in the quotes (I used +18% comp hiring growth for FY27 in the spreadsheet).
- If approved, Dev — can procurement start a consolidated PO and coordinate DocuSign?

Highlights from the attachment (renewal_summary_2026.xlsx):
- Greenhouse: renewal base $182k/yr; vendor offered 12% if we commit to a 24-month term and amortize seats.
- Checkr: standard per-check rate unchanged; offering 6-month price lock if bundled with Greenhouse. See checkr_price_lock_2026.pdf.
- LearnPort: proposed SOW for new onboarding program + 12-month portal license; vendor willing to waive implementation fee if we sign by 8/15.

Risks/notes:
- We need legal sign-off on the extended Greenhouse term (auto-renewal language).
- Billing cadence: Greenhouse prefers annual; LearnPort wants upfront 50% on SOW.

Proposed next steps:
1) Finance (Markus/Karthik) quick sanity check on budget/PO approach.
2) If ok, Dev opens consolidated PO and I’ll route vendor DocuSign links to legal/procurement.
3) Schedule 30-min call with Greenhouse + Checkr rep to lock final numbers.

Attachments: renewal_summary_2026.xlsx, greenhouse_quote_20260722.pdf, checkr_price_lock_2026.pdf, learnport_sow_v3.docx

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Greenhouse + Checkr + LearnPort — renewal bundling proposal

Thanks Monica — this looks reasonable at a high level. A couple quick items:

- Confirm that the 12% Greenhouse discount is off list and that seat counts are firm; we should capture a vendor commitment in writing before committing to a two-year term.
- Agree to a consolidated PO if it reduces total spend and simplifies invoicing. Dev, please confirm operationally whether a single PO can cover three separate vendors (we may need separate invoices but single budget object).

Karthik / Legal: please flag any concerns on the term length + auto-renew clauses in the greenhouse_quote_20260722.pdf.

If we get vendor confirmations this week I’ll provisionally approve from a budget perspective.

-Markus
VP, Finance
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-07-23T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Vendor confirmations — Greenhouse & Checkr

Subject: Re: Greenhouse + Checkr + LearnPort — renewal bundling proposal

All — quick follow up from finance/legal side before we route signatures:

1) Headcount assumption: Monica, please confirm the hires by role/quarter used in the renewal_summary_2026.xlsx. We need this to forecast committed spend.
2) Billing cadence: If Greenhouse invoices annually and LearnPort wants 50% upfront, we should confirm cashflow impact; Markus to sign-off on upfront vendor payment(s).
3) Legal redlines: I reviewed the draft Greenhouse amendment — need to remove automatic auto-renew without a notice window and add SLA language for support response times.

Dev: once headcount confirmation is provided we can approve budget and you can raise the PO.

-Karthik
Head of FP&A (acting counsel on vendor agreements)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>

Subject: Final: bundle approval + DocuSign links routed

Team — quick final note:

- Headcount confirmation: Q3 hires are as in the sheet (Engineering 9, Product 4, Sales 5, Ops 2). I updated the sheet and re-attached renewal_summary_2026.xlsx.
- I reviewed the Greenhouse amendment; Jasmine flagged the auto-renew language. Karthik, I agree with your redlines — please send the one-paragraph change to Ellie and request the SLA addition.
- I’m comfortable with annual billing for Greenhouse. LearnPort will receive a 50% upfront invoice; we will budget for it in August.

Dev — please open PO PO-2026-1347 (use budget object HR-APP-2026) and collect invoices from vendors. I’m going to route the three DocuSign envelopes now:
  - Greenhouse: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/gh-2026-07-23
  - Checkr: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ch-2026-07-24
  - LearnPort SOW: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/lp-2026-07-27

Attachments: renewal_summary_2026.xlsx, learnport_sow_v3.docx

Thanks everyone — I’ll join the vendor call Friday to close outstanding items.

Monica Patel
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
